prompts.clay: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE square seamless repeating game-terrain ALBEDO texture, 1024 x 1024, viewed exactly straight down, flat edge-to-edge swatch. Primary request: pale sun-dried cracked clay for dry desert basin floors in FirstSettlers, a natural softly painted stylized survival world. Style: restrained hand-painted realism, broad quiet color planes and soft mineral variation, matching muted grey/taupe painted rocks and warm sandy ground; no cartoon outlines, no photorealistic grain. Material: irregular interlocking clay plates, roughly 9 to 13 varied plates across the tile width, dusty limestone-beige, warm pale buff and desaturated clay-taupe; fine subdued reddish ochre variation. Narrow shallow darker hairline shrinkage cracks, some faint branching cracks, largely level broad smooth plate interiors. Keep cracks restrained and softly edged, no black chasms, no highly curled raised flakes. This is dry hardpan, no water or mud gloss. Colors predominantly light warm beige, not orange or dark brown. Lighting: perfectly diffuse unlit base color, no directional light, cast shadows, sun glare or baked highlights. Composition: natural irregular size variation without a central focal feature, wrapped patterns continue seamlessly across all four opposite edges. No vegetation, pebbles, footprints, objects, text, borders or transparency. Deliver only the texture itself, not a scene or material sphere. Small restrained surface detail so it reads cleanly at walking distance and tiles unobtrusively across a large basin.
prompts.gravel: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE square seamless repeating game-terrain ALBEDO texture, 1024 x 1024, viewed exactly straight down, flat edge-to-edge swatch. Primary request: dry desert-wash gravel and compacted sandy silt for FirstSettlers, a natural softly painted stylized survival world. Style: restrained hand-painted realism matching broad muted grey/taupe painted rocks and warm sandy ground, quiet low contrast, softly simplified mineral surfaces, no outlined cartoon stones and no photorealistic noisy grain. Material: a continuous firm pale buff-taupe sandy silt substrate with scattered small flat angular sandstone chips, a few softly rounded pebbles and thin patches of fine pale gravel; mostly clear substrate and some loose clustered deposits with subtle flow-sorted variation but no strong directional stripes. Colors: warm dusty beige, restrained sandstone ochre, subdued limestone cream, occasional quiet grey-taupe stone. Keep all stones small and embedded, not cobblestone paving or a pile of boulders. Broad calm variation so it stays readable beside sand dunes and layered cliffs. Lighting: evenly lit unlit base color only; no cast shadows, no glossy wet surfaces or directional highlights. Composition: irregular natural coverage, no central focal object, periodic continuous matching opposite edges, tileable on all four sides. No vegetation, roots, leaves, shells, footprints, objects, water, mud, text, borders or transparency. Deliver only the texture itself, not a landscape or material sphere.
